video_title: Cason Wallace on His Bigger Role in OKC, Wemby Rivalry & Kiki Rice Almost BEATING Him 1-on-1

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on his journey from writing about NBA dreams to living them
quotes.excerpt: just to know that that little kid is here in this present moment, about to have his first NBA championship
quotes.quote: I've always had dreams and wrote them down. I'm in elementary school writing on my history papers, my school work, that I'm in the NBA, winning championships. Just to know that that little kid is here in this present moment, about to have his first NBA championship, it's deeper than a dream come true.

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on his focus on skill training over summer league games
quotes.excerpt: I didn't do any runs. Only thing I did was I worked with my trainer and I did a whole lot of skill work.
quotes.quote: I didn't do any runs. Only thing I did was I worked with my trainer and I did a whole lot of skill work. That was my summertime workouts. I would go back home and play half-court pickup basketball back home. So I would go home every now and then. I remember I took Mike Miller down there and we went and played at the park.

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on his approach to creating space and reading the game
quotes.excerpt: Basketball is about creating the space to get the shot. I don't give a damn how many moves you do.
quotes.quote: I think I trained how I played, and that was getting to my spots and just really being efficient on different counters and things of that nature, working on the spots that I operated in. Basketball is about creating the space to get the shot. I don't give a damn how many moves you do. If you can't create no space, you could be the fastest person on the basketball court and if you can't create no space, you're not going to get a shot off.

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on his preference for running off screens over chasing players
quotes.excerpt: I don't want to be chasing guys off screens. I don't want to be chasing you like I'm chasing Rip Hamilton.
quotes.quote: The one thing we don't want to do is we don't want to be chasing guys off screens. I don't want to be chasing you like I'm chasing Rip Hamilton. If you would have done that, I would have struggled guarding you every single time because I don't want to be running off all these screens. So that's why I learned how to run off of screens because I'm not going to have you play me like run our touch. Y'all are going to play totally different. I know run is really good when you're sitting dancing with the ball, he's at his best.

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on his strategy of using pick-and-rolls to manipulate defenders
quotes.excerpt: That's why we put Kobe in a lot of pick-and-rolls. He's at some point, he's going to relax.
quotes.quote: That's why we put Kobe in a lot of pick-and-rolls. He's at some point, he's going to relax and you're going to be able to attack Shaq. So that's why we put Kobe in a lot of pick-and-rolls. You can't play everybody the same, right? So that's why and that's why I just it's that's becoming a dynamic scorer is not being able to just be effective on the ball, but being able to do all of those multiple things.

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on his evolution and learning the league over four years
quotes.excerpt: I'm going into year four now. So I kind of yeah, it went fast. I'm not going to lie.
quotes.quote: So, past summers was more of like learn a lot about different situations. So, I'm putting myself in many different situations because I don't know what my role will be in the league. It's my first year or two. Now I'm going into year four now. So I kind of yeah, it went fast. I'm not going to lie. It went fast. I'm going into year four and I understand the league now. So really sharpening my tools now. Like I have a lot of tools in my bag, it's just to sharpen them up right now.

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on his defensive mindset and learning from Lu Dort
quotes.excerpt: In my opinion, the best on-ball guard defender in the league. Like he's so solid.
quotes.quote: Defensively, I'm just you know, last season we had a lot of great defenders. Know, shout out Lu. In my opinion, the best on-ball guard defender in the league. Like he's so solid. He doesn't gamble too often. He's one of the best guard defenders in the league, for sure. Like toughest assignment every night, like easily, it's him. So it's like just learning a lot through my teammates, really, him, Alex Caruso, Jalen Williams.

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on the competitive nature of the NBA and scoring mentality
quotes.excerpt: I learned that in the league, everybody wakes up and wants to score.
quotes.quote: I learned that in the league, everybody wakes up and wants to score. And they have their go-tos and it's like they're waking up and they're like, I'm going to get 30 tonight and they're thinking about how they want to get 30. And like as a defender and like I take pride in flipping that. So I'm like, okay, how do I keep him under his average? And for me, the first few years is like that was that was fun for me.

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on his rookie year goal of learning the league
quotes.excerpt: My whole goal was to learn as much as I could about the league.
quotes.quote: My whole goal was to learn as much as I could about the league. So it was like I went into the offseason knowing that everybody had their go-to move. And the amount of times that I could keep them from doing that go-to move is a win for me in my opinion. So it took more film and you know, just just learning the players more. Second year, I got them to do it less and then it was like, okay, I got to get stronger because they're very physical.

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on the team culture and brotherhood in Oklahoma City
quotes.excerpt: We've all created a bond that will last forever. You know, it's when you're on a team like that.
quotes.quote: We've all created a bond that will last forever. You know, it's when you're on a team like that, it makes everything everything so much better. You know, a good locker room that carries over to the court, and then the talent that we have and you know, it just we're seeing our brothers win. That's the best feeling ever.

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on the team's 'big AAU team' dynamic
quotes.excerpt: We're a group of big kids really. Like we're we say it all the time, we're a big AAU team.
quotes.quote: We're a group of big kids really. Like we're we say it all the time, we're a big AAU team. Like it's serious and it's not serious at the same time.

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on the tough playoff series against Denver and Indiana
quotes.excerpt: It was close between Denver and Indiana for sure because Indiana, that was our first time making it.
quotes.quote: It was close between Denver and Indiana for sure because Indiana, that was our first time making it that far into the season. So like mentally, it's like, okay, like we got to we got to keep pushing, you know? We we just lost this game pretty bad. Like we got to we got to shake back. But Denver is like going up against Jokic, the great team with a lot of pieces. We're going to Denver and you know, the altitude is a real thing. And the crowds are crazy.

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on his mentality after a tough playoff loss
quotes.excerpt: I let it sink in like, yo, you got to be better. Like that was the only thing that went
quotes.quote: After the game, of course, I let it sink in like, yo, you got to be better. Like that was the only thing that went to my mind. I got to be better. Then we go through the film and it's like, okay, I gave him a shot that he's comfortable like the film says and his stats say that he's comfortable shooting. Like going right to the wing, that's the shot that he's consistently makes and it's happened every single time. So I just hated that it was on me and that it even happened in the first place.

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on guarding Kyrie Irving and the challenge of his game
quotes.excerpt: Kyrie, his bag is like it's hard to watch film on him. Like you watch film and every
quotes.quote: Kyrie, his bag is like it's hard to watch film on him. Like you watch film and every clip is different. So like, what else? And it's all buckets, so it's he's number two.

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on Coach Calipari's ability to build players up
quotes.excerpt: He's one of the best at building players up in my opinion. Um, he he knows your game
quotes.quote: He's one of the best at building players up in my opinion. Um, he he knows your game like to a T pretty much and he like he limits you to what you do best at first. And once you're like very dominant at that, then he lets you like now he's like, okay, like you get it now and he gives you a lot more than he lets you grow.

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on his college experience and learning from teammates
quotes.excerpt: Her class is my class really. So I known I knew all of them from McDonald's and just
quotes.quote: Her class is my class really. So I known I knew all of them from McDonald's and just growing up. So like I kind of lived a college life through them a little bit, honestly. So, but just seeing them and her, you know, just accomplish their goals like they've been saying they want to make it to the final four and they got their junior year and then senior year they're like, we're all seniors, like let's just do it, like.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on his competitive 1-on-1 games with Kiki Rice
quotes.excerpt: If she beat me, I would give her all the credit in the world.

text_blocks.text: What was the score? She score, bro? 5-4?

text_blocks.speaker: Cason Wallace
text_blocks.text: I would say the highest she got was 4. It was a game. It was a game point. And you was playing C-dub defense, bro?

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: Okay. She got that. That's number one. And here's the next one. So you're trying to tell me she did not win a spot, though?

text_blocks.speaker: Cason Wallace
text_blocks.text: If she beat me, I would give her all the credit in the world. I would overhype her win.

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: Bro, I'm impressed she scored four points on him.

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on the impact of Kiki Rice's shoulder injury
quotes.excerpt: She had her shoulder injury, and then our seasons never really matched up.

text_blocks.speaker: Cason Wallace
text_blocks.text: It's been a while. She had her shoulder injury, and then our seasons never really matched up, so I haven't really had a chance to really play for real.

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: So, ain't no disrespect in these WNBA players. They really got game like that.

text_blocks.speaker: Cason Wallace
text_blocks.text: Once this shoulder injury comes around, she's going to be.

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on Kiki Rice's competitive drive and shooting ability
quotes.excerpt: She doesn't care about none of that. She just wants to go out and compete.
quotes.quote: That's what I love about it. She doesn't care about none of that. She just wants to go out and compete. She just wants to beat me. Whether it's the shooting game, who's the better shooter, or the drill. She can shoot. I know. She can shoot. She's one in shooting game, for sure.
